searchText: Not really apropos of anything, but here is a distribution of gas usage for the deposit contract on Topaz (successful direct transactions only). Main takeaway is that a "safe" gas limit is north of 400,000; 450,000 seems reasonable (or 500,000 if you want to be sure). Yeah, the iterative merkle tree in the contract provides huge gas savings (across the board) but at the cost of being highly variable I did find it cool that you can so clearly see the steps (those frequencies are literally 50%, 25%, 12.5%, ~6.28%, after which the fixed costs start to ruin it) yeah, cool!
